name: aider
label: Aider
description: AI pair programming in your terminal

env_config.name: AIDER_PROVIDER
env_config.description: Which provider the API key belongs to. One of: auto, openai, anthropic, openrouter, gemini, deepseek, openai-compatible. `auto` infers from the model name; set it explicitly when the model name doesn't identify the provider.

env_config.name: AIDER_MODEL
env_config.description: Model to use, e.g. sonnet, gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, openrouter/anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet, gemini/gemini-1.5-pro, deepseek/deepseek-chat. May be left blank to let Aider auto-select — but if you set LLM_API_KEY, the provider must be determinable (via AIDER_PROVIDER or the model name).

env_config.name: LLM_API_KEY
env_config.description: API key for the selected provider. Injected into the provider env var chosen by AIDER_PROVIDER/model. Leave blank to reuse a provider key already in your shell or the project's .env / .aider.conf.yml.

env_config.name: LLM_BASE_URL
env_config.description: Endpoint URL — ONLY for AIDER_PROVIDER=openai-compatible (self-hosted / relay / local). Becomes OPENAI_API_BASE; leave blank for hosted providers.

check_ready.not_ready_message: No model API key — set a model + LLM_API_KEY (or a provider key such as OPENAI_API_KEY) — press e to configure

name: nanoclaw
label: NanoClaw
description: Containerized agent runtime — each Agent Group runs in its own Docker container (Claude Agent SDK). Bridged to the Workspace via a native OpenAgents channel.

install.macos: echo 'NanoClaw is an external containerized runtime. Set it up from https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw (clone, pnpm install, ./nanoclaw.sh setup), symlink bin/ncl onto your PATH, then install the OpenAgents channel: see docs/nanoclaw.md (/add-openagents).'
install.linux: echo 'NanoClaw is an external containerized runtime. Set it up from https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw (clone, pnpm install, ./nanoclaw.sh setup), symlink bin/ncl onto your PATH, then install the OpenAgents channel: see docs/nanoclaw.md (/add-openagents).'
install.windows: echo 'NanoClaw requires Docker Desktop + WSL2 on Windows. Set it up inside WSL2 from https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw, symlink bin/ncl onto your PATH, then install the OpenAgents channel: see docs/nanoclaw.md (/add-openagents).'

env_config.name: NANOCLAW_HOME
env_config.description: Path to your NanoClaw checkout (optional if `ncl` is on PATH)

env_config.name: NANOCLAW_AGENT_GROUP
env_config.description: NanoClaw Agent Group id or name to bridge to this agent

check_ready.not_ready_message: Set NANOCLAW_AGENT_GROUP (and NANOCLAW_HOME) — press e to configure

name: mini-swe-agent
label: mini-SWE-agent
description: A minimal shell-based coding agent for fixing issues and modifying code in a workspace.

env_config.name: MSWEA_MODEL_NAME
env_config.description: Model to use (routed through LiteLLM), e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5 or gpt-4o. Optional when a model is already configured via a config file or `mini-extra config setup`. Passed as --model.

env_config.name: MSWEA_MINI_CONFIG_PATH
env_config.description: Path to a FULL mini config file (YAML). Optional. This REPLACES mini's built-in default config (agent prompt templates, step/environment settings) — it does not merge — so provide a complete file (a good starting point is the output of `mini-extra config setup`). Leave blank to use mini's default config.

env_config.name: MSWEA_COST_LIMIT
env_config.description: Optional per-run cost limit in USD, passed as --cost-limit. Leave blank for mini's default.

env_config.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env_config.description: Anthropic API key — used when the model is an Anthropic model. Leave blank if using another provider or a key already in your environment.

env_config.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
env_config.description: Custom endpoint for native `anthropic/…` models (an enterprise gateway or Anthropic-protocol relay). Leave blank for hosted Anthropic. Note: most third-party relays are OpenAI-compatible — for those use an `openai/…` model + OPENAI_BASE_URL instead.

env_config.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env_config.description: OpenAI API key — used when the model is an OpenAI model. Leave blank if using another provider or a key already in your environment.

env_config.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
env_config.description: Custom endpoint for OpenAI-compatible models (a relay/proxy or self-hosted gateway) — applies only to `openai/…` models. Leave blank for hosted OpenAI, or for native providers like `deepseek/…` / `anthropic/…`.

env_config.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
env_config.description: DeepSeek API key — used when the model is a `deepseek/…` model (e.g. deepseek/deepseek-chat or deepseek/deepseek-reasoner). Connects directly to api.deepseek.com; no base URL needed.

env_config.name: DEEPSEEK_API_BASE
env_config.description: Custom endpoint for native `deepseek/…` models. Leave blank to use DeepSeek's default (api.deepseek.com).

check_ready.not_ready_message: mini-SWE-agent CLI detected. Configure a model through environment variables (MSWEA_MODEL_NAME + a provider key), a full config file (MSWEA_MINI_CONFIG_PATH), or the Model field before running a task.
